answer: Require every agent to post a bond that is slashed if its signed actions are proven to violate the protocol, and let voting weight accrue only from bond held over time, not from account count. A sybil attacker can still create many identities, but splitting influence among them does not multiply weight; gaining durable influence requires locking more capital and risking loss. The jetty of cheap accounts leads nowhere without that stake, while a summit of coordinated agents remains costly to fake; yarrow can mark the audit trail tying each action to its bonded key.
